tup.title: Universal Transfer of Assets (TUP)
tup.subtitle: The simplified solution to dissolve your subsidiary
tup.article: Article 1844-5 of the French Civil Code
tup.whatIsDesc: The Universal Transfer of Assets (TUP) is a legal mechanism provided by Article 1844-5 of the French Civil Code. It allows the dissolution of a company whose shares are all held by a single shareholder, without the need for liquidation proceedings.
tup.step1: All shares gathered by the sole shareholder
tup.step2: Publication of dissolution in the Legal Gazette
tup.step4: Automatic transfer of all assets and liabilities
tup.adv1: No need to appoint a liquidator
tup.adv3: Reduced timeline (30 days vs several months)
tup.adv6: Automatic transfer of assets and liabilities
tup.eligibilityDesc: TUP is applicable when all shares of a company are held by a single shareholder (natural or legal person).
